summary: Iteration 51: retest of the iteration_50 findings. I used the same worst-mode odd rows (7 snapshot rows 99990001-7 in the latest TEST_Shot snapshot, save_no 7, and 8 pool rows 99991001-8). None of these rows has a contract_end, avg_rating or wage key; wage was also removed from the BASE rows. Full sweep of 122 parameter-free GET routes: no regressions. Every route returns the same status with and without the odd rows. The only non-200s are the same 11 routes that return 422 on clean data because they need parameters. /api/home and /api/scouting/rankings now return 200. Pytest test_iter51_odd_rows_nokeys.py passes 33/33. Club Analysis 'What to do first' items are the same with and without the odd rows (no false 'Ageing' items). Youth Development shows '—' for the age of the 3 unknown-age rows. Home renders real content with no fallback. Squad and Scouting also render, with no page errors. I removed the inserted rows by unique_id. Counts are back to 23 snapshot players and 204 pool players.

minor.issue: This is still a minutes-weighted (r['age'] or 0) average. It does not skip age 99 or age_unknown rows. The sweep showed no failure because history squads come from a separate source, but the same sentinel could leak here if odd rows reach it.

ui_bugs.issue: Rows with no avg_rating show '0' instead of '—', because clean_player sets avg_rating to 0.0. The frontend already shows '—' for null. Cosmetic only.

action_items: Optional: keep avg_rating as None, not 0.0, when it is missing, so the tables show '—'. scouting_api already handles a falsy avg_rating, but check its `(p['avg_rating'] or 6.0)` and the diff logic after the change.
Optional: leave age_unknown and age 99 out of history_api.py:424 squad_age.
critical_code_review_comments: analysis_api.py:314 leaves out age 99 even when it is a real age 99, and also leaves out age 0. That is acceptable.
clean_player now normalises wage, avg_rating and contract_end (an ISO check, otherwise None). The dashboard.py:57 guard is correct.
